archetypes.name: dyn-progress-dispatch
archetypes.rationale: Review Step 5 versus ship-pr progress-report precedence after stale state files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/progress_report.py _render_implement and the dispatch regression in python/test_progress_report.py. Verify live Step 5 round evidence takes precedence over stale ship-pr state while genuine ship-pr phases and done runs still render as intended. Check edge cases around empty PHASE, missing timing marks, and stale mark fallback. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
